dedupe_keys.name: bahrain oil and gas open data crude oil production and imports refinery throughput and output local sales of petroleum products associated and non associated gas production

description: Seven annual tables that Bahrain's Ministry of Oil and Environment publishes under the Oil & Gas theme of the national open data portal, linked from the Open Data page of the ministry's site: Bahrain Field crude oil production (thousand US barrels), imports of crude oil, refinery throughput of crude oil and feedstock, refinery production, local sales of petroleum products by product (for example Super 98 and Mumtaz gasoline, diesel), associated gas production and non-associated gas production (million cubic feet). Each table covers 2017 to 2025 (for example crude production of 16,145 thousand barrels in 2017 and 13,505 in 2025); the portal shows the tables as modified on 6 and 10 August 2026. Coverage: national, Bahrain. Format and access: an Opendatasoft portal with table views and exports and a free JSON API (explore v2.1), with labels in English and Arabic. Licence: not stated in the dataset metadata. Caveats: annual national totals only, with no field, plant or pipeline detail; the refinery tables reflect Bapco's operations. Simulation uses: capacity planning and supply chain scenarios for Gulf fuel supply, and resilience studies of refinery outages. Related records: comparable to the JODI Oil World Database (data-jodi-oil-world-database), which reports monthly national oil statistics.
